Lina (AE): Heads up — Curlew Therapeutics asks for a 6-month evaluation at $90k (they quoted $130k list). Asking for 30% off plus Net60 payment terms. They’re a strategic biotech partner, potential ARR $1.2M in 18 months. Need internal ok to proceed. Quote: https://redwood.app/quotes/QL-4982 @Omar (Finance) @Priya (RevOps)
Omar (Finance): Net60 is outside standard. We usually do Net30 for pilots unless prepay. Any reason they need Net60 vs Net45? Also 30% is > standard maximum discount. Can we get a signed PO and procurement approval?
Lina (AE): Procurement requires Net60; they can't approve Net30. They will prepay if we insist, but that kills renewal momentum. They expect the discount to be on invoice 1 only.
Priya (RevOps): I can accept up to 20% without escalation. For >20% need CFO signoff + Salesforce exception entry. Also we require a conversion trigger and clawback clause.
Lina (AE): Understood. Customer is flexible on clawback but wants the discount to apply regardless of conversion.
Omar (Finance): Quick back-of-envelope:
```
List = $130,000
Requested = $90,000 -> ~30.8% off
Revenue deferral and margin hit ~ $35k vs list after COGS
```
If Net60 we should hold credit check and include late payment fee language. Also need tax team input if we invoice outside of usual terms.
Tom (CFO): I can approve a special pilot concession up to 25% + Net45. For Net60 + 30% we'd need exec sponsorship and a signed business case from AE showing ARR pipeline and timeline. Also require an auto-invoice clause: if PO not received within 10 days of signature, invoice moves to Net30.
Lina (AE): I can get a one-page business case ASAP — will include projected ARR and exec contact. Would team accept 25% + Net45 + $10k implementation credit as alternate?
Priya (RevOps): That’s workable procedurally. I'll draft the SFDC exception reason: `strategic-bio-pilot` and add renewal reminders and the clawback workflow. Which option to present to customer?
Lina (AE): Present Option 1: 30% + Net60 (preferred by customer) but tell them we need exec sign-off and might add the PO timeline clause. Option 2: 25% + Net45 + $10k credit as fallback.
contracts-bot: Draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood.app/ctr/CTR-9923. Please confirm special terms: `clawback if no conversion within 12 months`, `PO submission timeline 10 days`, `late fee 1.5%/month after due date`
Omar (Finance): Please ensure accounting treatment is noted: if we take upfront credit, recognize per ASC606 schedule; if invoiced with Net60, record receivable and track DSO impact. I'll prepare memo once final option chosen.
Tom (CFO): Approve Option 2 (25% + Net45 + $10k credit) now for faster turnaround. If AE gets exec sponsor and business case today, I will consider Option 1.
Lina (AE): Got it. I'll submit business case + customer exec intro by EOD. Thanks.
Priya (RevOps): I'll queue the SFDC exception now and attach the contract draft.
Lina (AE): Will post PO/contract signed timestamp here once received. :thumbsup:
